sessions.phase_label: Model review, scope definition, and input collection
Technical clarification and base-case model build
Usability redesign, dashboard refinement, and delivery
Deliverable rejection, replacement, and engagement closeout

requirements.title: Twelve-Site Network Structure
requirements.definition: Represent the final Business Case twelve-site network and model its gateway, regional, and corridor-support sites at an appropriate site level, including modeled treatment of unavailable site details.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers which sites and typologies the model represents; revenue, capex, and opex calculations are independently adjustable mechanisms.

requirements.title: Separate Revenue-Stream Modeling
requirements.definition: Model parking, pods, fleet contracts or subscriptions, digital-platform revenue, and ancillary revenue as distinct driver-based streams.
requirements.boundary_note: The named streams are parameters of one revenue-modeling mechanism; cost modeling and funding scenarios can change independently.

requirements.title: Site-Level Capital Expenditure Modeling
requirements.definition: Build site-level capex by site typology using the authorized midpoint assumptions while definitive capex figures remain unavailable.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers site-specific build costs; shared digital-platform, program-management, and reserve costs have a separate required treatment.

requirements.title: Program-Wide Capex Line Items
requirements.definition: Include digital-platform, program-management, and contingency or reserve costs as separate line items within total program capex.
requirements.boundary_note: Separate from site capex because these shared costs can be included, excluded, or presented differently without changing site-level cost calculations.

requirements.title: Operating Expenditure Modeling
requirements.definition: Model operating costs by relevant cost drivers using the client-confirmed full-network annual opex range rather than the understated Appendix amount.
requirements.boundary_note: Opex has its own disputed input basis and can be corrected independently of capex or revenue calculations.

requirements.title: Base-Case Financing Structure
requirements.definition: Represent the approved streamlined capital structure, including the debt/equity proportions, interest-rate assumption, and omission of a separate mezzanine layer at this stage.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers financing inputs and tranche structure; debt amortization, coverage calculations, and return outputs remain independently testable.

requirements.title: Debt Schedule and Coverage Analysis
requirements.definition: Produce a functioning debt schedule and calculate debt-performance measures, including DSCR, for the modeled funding cases.
requirements.boundary_note: Debt mechanics and coverage can fail independently of the selected financing inputs or the availability-payment sizing rule.

requirements.title: Project and Equity Return Analysis
requirements.definition: Calculate and communicate project and equity returns, including the equity IRR needed to evaluate viability and investor attractiveness.
requirements.boundary_note: Return calculation is distinct from dashboard presentation and from using a return target to size the availability payment.

requirements.title: Availability-Payment Sizing
requirements.definition: Size the availability-style payment so the modeled PPP case meets both the minimum DSCR target and the required equity IRR range rather than relying on DSCR alone.
requirements.boundary_note: The DSCR and equity-IRR thresholds are coupled parameters of one payment-sizing mechanism; the broader comparison of funding cases is separate.

requirements.title: User-Funded and PPP Scenario Comparison
requirements.definition: Model and compare the user-funded Case F with the PPP Case G that includes an availability payment, using separate cash-flow results.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the existence and comparability of the two requested cases; the required conclusion about user-fee insufficiency is a separate submission outcome.

requirements.title: Evidence for Availability-Payment Necessity
requirements.definition: Clearly demonstrate that user fees alone do not make the project viable or bankable and that an availability-style payment is therefore necessary.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the required decision-making conclusion supported by the model, not merely the numerical algorithm used to size a payment.

requirements.title: Tax and CCA Modeling
requirements.definition: Replace the flat tax-on-EBITDA treatment with asset-appropriate Canadian Capital Cost Allowance and depreciation calculations that capture the tax shield and its effect on equity returns.
requirements.boundary_note: The listed CCA classes are parameters of one tax mechanism; this behavior can be corrected independently of financing and operating assumptions.

requirements.title: Three-Statement Financial Model
requirements.definition: Retain or build an integrated three-statement financial structure as part of the rebuilt project model.
requirements.boundary_note: Statement integration is an independently executable model structure rather than an attribute of dashboard presentation or scenario selection.

requirements.title: Project Sensitivity Analysis
requirements.definition: Run sensitivities for traffic, occupancy, capex, interest rates, and opex so the effects of uncertain assumptions can be assessed.
requirements.boundary_note: The sensitivity dimensions are parameters of one analysis mechanism and should not be split into separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Model Currency and Price Base
requirements.definition: Use the client-specified reporting currency and 2031 price base consistently throughout the model.
requirements.boundary_note: Currency and price year form one model-basis mechanism; the later CAD-denominated opex instruction requires value-level clarification rather than a broader Requirement.

requirements.title: Assumption Disclosure and Traceability
requirements.definition: Base provisional inputs on the supplied brief, business case, demand study, and authorized market assumptions, while clearly flagging assumptions and tracing modeled figures to their sources.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers provenance and disclosure of inputs; computational correctness and visual comprehensibility are separately testable.

requirements.title: Model Calculation Integrity
requirements.definition: Ensure entered data, formulas, cross-sheet links, calculations, and resulting outputs are internally correct, coherent, and credible.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an acceptance condition of the executable model, not a generic testing or debugging process Requirement.

requirements.title: Simplified and Understandable Model
requirements.definition: Provide a model structure that is simple enough for the client and reviewers to follow, understand, and audit without losing the necessary underlying detail.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers navigation and comprehensibility of the working model; dashboard contents and professional visual formatting can be modified independently.

requirements.title: Decision-Maker Dashboard
requirements.definition: Provide dashboards that clearly communicate essential decision information, including project returns, debt performance, viability, and bankability.
requirements.boundary_note: Dashboard communication is independently testable from the underlying calculations and from the general simplicity of the workbook.

requirements.title: Government-Ready Model Presentation
requirements.definition: Format and present the model professionally, clearly, and persuasively for government review and submission.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers professional submission quality and presentation strength; it excludes the unconfirmed standalone presentation-file proposal.

requirements.title: Excel Model Deliverable
requirements.definition: Maintain and deliver the working financial model in Excel rather than substituting a PDF with formatting limitations.
requirements.boundary_note: File format is independently actionable and remains separate from the workbook's visual quality or calculation correctness.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client specifies AUD as the model currency but later confirms a CAD-denominated opex range without stating whether it should be converted or retained in CAD. The currency treatment requires lifecycle-level clarification.
A separate short presentation file was proposed and later claimed as delivered, but the supplied history does not show unambiguous client acceptance of that artifact as an independent Requirement.
Case H and the other alternative funding structures were freelancer proposals awaiting client selection; no client acceptance establishes any of them as required model cases.
